memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild lower back pain radiating to left leg, able to walk 500m with occasional rest, performs ADLs independently.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative), reports occasional forgetfulness but no impact on daily tasks.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy: review against Beers criteria requested.
mood: reports occasional frustration with pain, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: spouse Anita Kumar.
goals: "I want to stay active in my flower shop and keep pain under control."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: back pain worsened after stopping diclofenac due to gastric discomfort, now using paracetamol as needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (tripped at home, no injury); gait cautious; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised risk).
medicines: 8 regular (diclofenac stopped); polypharmacy: review against Beers criteria requested.
mood: reports frustration with pain and fall, denies depression.
carers: spouse Anita Kumar.
goals: "I want to avoid further falls and manage pain safely."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: back pain better with paracetamol and pregabalin, walks 900m, no recent falls.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative) – still below cutoff, plan for fuller cognitive assessment.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 8 regular; polypharmacy: review against Beers criteria requested.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies suicidal ideation.
carers: spouse Anita Kumar.
goals: "I want to stay independent and keep my mind sharp."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Lumbar spine X-ray: mild degenerative changes at L4-L5, no acute fracture or significant stenosis. Straight leg raise test negative bilaterally.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to physiotherapy accepted; patient attended 6 sessions, reports improved core strength and reduced back pain intensity. Advised to continue home exercise programme.
